category.description: Groups the page in sidebar sections that list this category.

order.description: Sort position inside its category (lowest first, then by title).

aliases.description: Other names that [[links]] and search accept.

items.description: Items this page covers; [[item:...]] links to them point here.

icon.description: Item whose icon represents the page. Defaults to the first of items.

summary.description: One or two sentences for search results, meta description and link previews.

hidden.description: Build the page but leave it out of the sidebar and search.

item.description: Shows this item's icon large at the top.

model.description: 3D model: a glTF path under assets/ ("models/wraith.glb") or a mob id from game-data/mobs.json ("cataclysm:ignis"). A list shows several mobs in one viewer.

itemRows.description: false leaves out the automatic Mod and ID rows, for pages that only borrow the item's icon (quests).

rows.description: [label, markdown value] pairs, or { "heading": "..." } to start a section.
